instruction: Ensure the ContextDB skill rejects legacy prompt-loading flags instead of documenting compatibility.
expected_outcome: Skill explicitly says deprecated prompt-loading flags are unsupported and names --startup-mode, --context-mode, and CTXDB_AUTO_PROMPT.
required_patterns: Deprecated prompt-loading flags are intentionally unsupported

instruction: Ensure manual report export is not treated as model prompt material.
expected_outcome: Skill tells agents never to paste a full ContextDB Report into a model prompt by default.
required_patterns: Never paste a full ContextDB Report

expected_outcome: Skill says startup summary is local-only and user must explicitly name the task or handoff to continue.
required_patterns: must not pass that summary as model input
user must explicitly name the task/handoff to continue

instruction: Ensure durable rules live in static instruction files and skills.
expected_outcome: Skill places durable workflow constraints in AGENTS/CLAUDE/GEMINI and skills rather than runtime injection.
required_patterns: Durable workflow constraints belong in checked-in instruction files
